findNode: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || for r in "$HOME/.local/share/fnm" "$HOME/AppData/Roaming/fnm" "$FNM_DIR"; do for n in "$(ls -d "$r"/node-versions/*/installation 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1)" "$r/aliases/default/installation"; do if [ -f "$n/node.exe" ] || [ -f "$n/bin/node" ]; then PATH="$n/bin:$n:$PATH"; fi; done; done
simple: f="{projectDir}/{entry}"; {findNode}; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" {event} --agent {agent}; exit 0
start: f="{projectDir}/{entry}"; {findNode}; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Node is missing from PATH, so the Workflow Kit hooks (kit check, Ponytail, Impeccable) do not run. Install Node {node} or newer and restart the session."}'; exit 0; }; [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" {event} --agent {agent}; exit 0
simpleWindows: $p = {projectDir}; $f = "$p/{entry}"; if ((Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { $input | node $f {event} --agent {agent}; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
startWindows: $p = {projectDir}; $f = "$p/{entry}"; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"Node is missing from PATH, so the Workflow Kit hooks (kit check, Ponytail, Impeccable) do not run. Install Node {node} or newer and restart the session."}'; exit 0 }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { $input | node $f {event} --agent {agent}; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
